parts.text: Deliveries carry a load from one site to another, and inspections take a drone with the right sensors to a list of points in a set order and bring it back to where the inspection started. Drones fly along corridors between named sites, and sites have only so many places where drones can take off and land at the same time. Before and during a flight, things happen outside our control: the load is ready or not, the drone reaches the points of its job, and the drone arrives.
